changes: doctor --repair now cleans terminal registered worktrees, orphan dirs, terminal dirs, stale .git/worktrees admin dirs, and terminal story branches with bounded timeouts; story_discard now repairs missing-path/prunable registry residue before writing DISCARDED metadata; story_list skips .koala-repair-ignore quarantined dirs; worktree-repair-smoke and cli-e2e were added/updated to cover repair safety and current INIT_CHECK reviewer gates.
usage: Run `koala doctor --repair` in a project root to clean DONE/DISCARDED worktree residue, then verify with `koala doctor`, `koala story_list`, and `git worktree list`. Run `npm --prefix packages/main run test:worktree-repair-smoke` for the focused regression smoke.
limitations: Physical directories that the operating system cannot delete are intentionally left in place with `.koala-repair-ignore`; Koala stops reporting them as terminal worktree issues, but manual filesystem/iCloud cleanup may still be needed outside Koala.
pitfalls: Global @koala-agent/core was linked to packages/main, so global-package verification changed the source repo directly. Review channel failed once because the implementation commit subject was `fix(...)`; normal channel accepts koala-prefixed commits, so the commit was reworded to `koala: repair terminal worktree cleanup`. Root npm test initially failed because cli-e2e still generated only one fake INIT reviewer; test-flow-e2e now writes both required reviewer signatures.
